title: Spring onion and halloumi hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, halloumi, spring onions, spinach, eggs, oil and smoked paprika are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, halloumi included, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a board and one large lidded frying pan, and the technique is simple frying.

works.reason: Thick slices covered for 15 minutes then crisped for 8 will cook through, the salty halloumi and paprika season it well, and the amounts suit four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for slicing the potatoes, halloumi and spring onions, and the steps add up to about 30 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Two bunches of April spring onions are used throughout, the whites fried and the greens scattered, alongside new potatoes and spinach, so they are central to a warm spring breakfast.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief and clear, in plain British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, greens, eggs and halloumi make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would happily cook again.
